title: Make project Vercel-deployable
description:
Convert the FastMCP server to be deployable on Vercel:
- Add vercel.json configuration
- Update build script with --vercel flag (npm run build -- --vercel)
- Configure for serverless function deployment
- Ensure environment variables (DOMO_HOST, DOMO_DEVELOPER_TOKEN) are handled properly
- Test with vercel deploy --prod --prebuilt

Reference: User's CLAUDE.md specifies using 'npm run build -- --vercel' and 'vercel deploy --prod --prebuilt' for XMCP Vercel deployments.
